caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a bald, smiling man standing on a dark green rectangular pedestal. The man is wearing a colorful outfit divided into quadrants of green, red, and yellow. His shirt features a large circular design at the chest, which includes a red star with a white circular center and green borders, containing a small face; yellow rays extend from the star. His pants are voluminous and divided diagonally, with the right leg red and the left leg green, and his top similarly divided between yellow, red, and green, with white cuffs at the sleeves and above the knees. The man is wearing dark shoes. His right arm is bent, and his hand forms an "OK" gesture, while the left arm hangs down by his side. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Figure: Clown
